scope: Local implementation and synthetic qualification only; no publication, live task edit, Cron or scoring.

officialSources.finding: PUT updates the exact task, normalizes startDate and replaces nonempty monthly daysOfMonth with the account-local start-date day before recomputing due state.
Start-date normalization preserves whole-quarter-hour instants with zero seconds/milliseconds; other values normalize using account offset. Due state delegates to shouldDo.
Stored Dailies support zero intervals, yearly/month-week forms and default-enabled weekday fields. Unsupported retained fields require explicit refusal rather than truncation.

implementationDecisions: Preserve the existing refusal for ordinary recurrence edits on linked tasks. Add a separately reviewed, exact linked-schedule path.
Only fixed UTC/Etc-GMT zones matching fresh account offset and midnight dayStart can promise parity.
The update-supported monthly subset has one day matching the local start date. Preserve complete before/after/provider-normalized facts.
A normal Daily PUT can also rewrite retained monthly rules; unsupported current schedules require a no-write guard.
Unknown writes keep the original command/attempt authority and never dispatch a replacement. Current provider equality alone must not claim an original schedule-write receipt.
